name: Hateful
overview: Scripture reveals that hateful speech and attitudes stem from a corrupt heart, as Jesus teaches that evil words flow from within and defile a person more than what enters the mouth (Matthew 12:34; 15:11,17). Believers are called to exercise righteous judgment rather than judging by outward appearances (John 7:24), recognizing that Satan’s influence seeks to corrupt and divide (Luke 10:18). Faith in God is essential to overcome such hatred, as it pleases Him when His people diligently seek Him and live by His truth (Hebrews 11:6).
